## Progress

- Merged [PR #40](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/40): quick registration saves as Incomplete until address and payer exist; completing closes it
- Merged [PR #61](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/61): quick form (5 fields, keyboard only) with the duplicate check; [PR #62](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/62) board card and [PR #58](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/58) record header show "Registration incomplete"
- Merged [PR #79](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/79): security fix — completion and registration writes reach the active facility's patients only; `POST /v1/patients/{id}/completion` (Full access): 200 + one Allowed row in the change's transaction, another facility's patient 404 + one NotFound row and nothing changed; mutation-checked
- Merged [PR #82](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/82): quick and full are one form with a mode toggle; switching keeps what was typed
- Merged [PR #84](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/84): the record of an Incomplete patient shows the completion task (what is missing: address, payer or both) and "Complete registration" (Register / book at Full) reusing the registration address and payer fields and rules; saving posts only those two to the facility-scoped completion endpoint, Complete closes the task and the tag; 404 announced, nothing changed; en/hi/ar, axe clean, keyboard, 200 % zoom, real-API browser check
- Merged [PR #86](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/86): the emergency contact is the third part the completion task waits for, added from the same completion form
- Left: CARE_TASK queue with owner and due date replaces the Incomplete status as the task (MDV-P4-016, recorded as a shortcut); timed 45-second usability check with a trained user (pilot)

## Description

Mode toggle "Quick (busy desk)" with minimum safe fields (India: full name, mobile, DOB or age, sex, ABHA optional; UAE: name as on EID, mobile, DOB, sex, Emirates ID). On save, a CARE_TASK-like front-desk completion task "Address, emergency contact and payer are missing" is added to the queue for the patient's next arrival; payer shows Missing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Quick registration can be completed in under 45 seconds by a trained user with keyboard only (timed usability check).
- [ ] **AC2.** After quick save, the patient card on the board and the patient header show an "Incomplete registration" tag until the task is closed.
- [ ] **AC3.** Completing the missing fields later closes the task automatically.
- [ ] **AC4.** Duplicate check (MDV-P1-016) still runs in quick mode.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
